review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner, regression design self-review
review.decision: Recognize already parked uncertain input across device renumbering and coalesce wake health notices
review.notes: Reviewed the installed release diagnostics and current main, including #1915's exact-turn witness. The reconstructed archived deliveries are diagnostic evidence only. Tests use temporary state, a fake clock and a fake notification driver.

cases.description: A parked unknown claim remains parked across a filesystem device-number change
cases.setup: A valid uncertain intent holds the original claim's inode and bytes. Its private pin and parked claim are hard links. The recorded device number differs from the current device number.
cases.action: Inspect native recovery twice through the normal recovery entry point.
cases.expected: There is no conflict for that parked claim. The journal, pin and parked bytes remain identical and no pending or sending file is created.

cases.description: A device-number change cannot authorize a different inode, live claim or changed content
cases.setup: Use separate synthetic uncertain intents with an original sending file, a replacement parked file with identical bytes, a changed original inode's bytes, or an absent parked file.
cases.action: Run native recovery and examine the protected set and original evidence.
cases.expected: Every ambiguous original remains protected. Neither replacement nor submission is performed. A separately verified parked claim is still recognized.

cases.description: Desktop health reports join simultaneous causes and do not repeat retained inventory
cases.setup: Use a fake desktop notifier, seeded v189 notice timestamps and synthetic health observations with a fake clock.
cases.action: Scan historical archives and refusals past their reminder interval, add new occurrences and simultaneous new causes, and keep an active stalled condition across scans. Check the independent workspace deadline channel.
cases.expected: Retained archives and refusals remain diagnosable without repeated desktop alerts. A new occurrence and newly active cause remain visible. Simultaneous channel reasons produce one desktop notice and one journal event. Active stalls and workspace deadlines keep their own rate-limited reminders.
